title: [BREAKING] Path tags change code generation in a strange way
body:
## Path tags affect code generation of the operations

If I have `tags` in my `paths` specification then `swagger` generates very strange code in `package operations`
Do you see how it overwrites handlers over and over?

``` go
func (o *TestAPI) initHandlerCache() {
    if o.context == nil {
        o.context = middleware.NewRoutableContext(o.spec, o, nil)
    }

    if o.handlers == nil {
        o.handlers = make(map[string]map[string]http.Handler)
    }

    if o.handlers["GET"] == nil {
        o.handlers[strings.ToUpper("GET")] = make(map[string]http.Handler)
    }
    o.handlers["GET"]["/payment/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}"] = invoices.NewGetPaymentByID(o.context, o.InvoicesGetPaymentByIDHandler)

    if o.handlers["GET"] == nil {
        o.handlers[strings.ToUpper("GET")] = make(map[string]http.Handler)
    }
    o.handlers["GET"]["/payment/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}"] = payments.NewGetPaymentByID(o.context, o.PaymentsGetPaymentByIDHandler)

    if o.handlers["GET"] == nil {
        o.handlers[strings.ToUpper("GET")] = make(map[string]http.Handler)
    }
    o.handlers["GET"]["/payment/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}"] = drama.NewGetPaymentByID(o.context, o.DramaGetPaymentByIDHandler)

    if o.handlers["GET"] == nil {
        o.handlers[strings.ToUpper("GET")] = make(map[string]http.Handler)
    }
    o.handlers["GET"]["/payment/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}"] = failure.NewGetPaymentByID(o.context, o.FailureGetPaymentByIDHandler)

    if o.handlers["GET"] == nil {
        o.handlers[strings.ToUpper("GET")] = make(map[string]http.Handler)
    }
    o.handlers["GET"]["/payment/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}"] = hot_mess.NewGetPaymentByID(o.context, o.HotMessGetPaymentByIDHandler)

}
```
## Swagger specification

``` yaml
swagger: '2.0'
info:
  version: 1.0.0
  title: Test
  description: "Test"
  termsOfService: 'test.com/'
host: api.test.com
basePath: /v1
schemes:
  - https
consumes:
  - application/json
produces:
  - application/json
paths:
  /payment/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}:
    get:
      description: Get payment info
      tags:
        - Invoices
        - Payments
        - Drama
        - Failure
        - HotMess
      operationId: getPaymentByID
      parameters:
        - name: invoice_id
          in: path
          description: Invoice ID
          required: true
          type: string
        - name: payment_id
          in: path
          description: Payment ID
          required: true
          type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Simple response
```
## Steps to reproduce

swagger version `0.5.0-81-gaeca3f0`
swagger generate server -f ./swagger.yaml -A test
